# Backend & Data Specification

This document outlines the architecture, data ownership, and API requirements for the Shruti Turner coaching platform. The system uses a hybrid approach: **Contentful** for editorial/marketing content and a **PostgreSQL Database** (managed via Prisma) for transactional/operational data.

**Key Principle:** If content is written by a human for marketing/editorial purposes and changes infrequently, it lives in Contentful. If it's generated by user actions, changes frequently, or contains private/financial data, it lives in the database.

**Existing System Context:** This platform is a migration from an existing production system. The database uses Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL. Authentication uses NextAuth.js (Account/Session model pattern). Payments use Stripe. Video uses Daily.co. The migration must preserve all existing user, booking, payment, and health data.

---

## 1. Contentful Content Models

All Contentful content types below are specified with their field name, field type, and any validation or help text for CMS editors.

### 1.1 Class Definition (the "Product")

This is the canonical description of a class type (e.g. "Adaptive Yoga Flow"). It does NOT represent a specific scheduled session -- that's in the database. One Class Definition may have many scheduled sessions over time.

| Field              | Type                          | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`             | Short Text                    | Yes      | e.g. "Adaptive Yoga Flow"                                                                                                                         |
| `slug`             | Short Text                    | Yes      | URL-safe, unique. e.g. `adaptive-yoga-flow`. Used in `/schedule/:slug` routes.                                                                    |
| `type`             | Short Text (enum)             | Yes      | One of: `Yoga`, `Strength`, `HIIT`. Powers filtering and badge colors.                                                                            |
| `level`            | Short Text                    | Yes      | e.g. "All levels", "Beginner", "Intermediate", "Specialised", "Adaptive"                                                                          |
| `defaultDay`       | Short Text                    | No       | e.g. "Monday". The typical recurring day for this class.                                                                                          |
| `defaultTime`      | Short Text                    | No       | e.g. "09:00". The typical recurring time (24hr format, GMT/BST).                                                                                  |
| `duration`         | Short Text                    | Yes      | e.g. "60 min", "45 min"                                                                                                                           |
| `maxCapacity`      | Integer                       | Yes      | Default cap for sessions of this class. e.g. 12. Can be overridden per-session in the DB.                                                         |
| `shortDescription` | Short Text                    | Yes      | One-liner for schedule cards and meta descriptions. Max 200 chars.                                                                                |
| `longDescription`  | Rich Text                     | Yes      | Full editorial description rendered on `/schedule/:slug`. Supports paragraphs, bold, italic, lists.                                               |
| `whatToExpect`     | List (Short Text)             | Yes      | Bullet points rendered under "What to Expect" on the class detail page.                                                                           |
| `whoItsFor`        | List (Short Text)             | Yes      | Bullet points rendered under "Who It's For".                                                                                                      |
| `benefits`         | List (Short Text)             | Yes      | Rendered as a grid of benefit cards.                                                                                                              |
| `equipment`        | List (Short Text)             | Yes      | Equipment list. Always append: "Don't have everything? Don't worry -- Shruti provides alternatives and substitutions at the start of each class." |
| `instructor`       | Reference (Instructor Bio)    | Yes      | Link to the instructor who teaches this class.                                                                                                    |
| `heroImage`        | Asset (Image)                 | No       | Optional hero image for the class detail page. If not set, use a type-based default.                                                              |
| `thumbnailImage`   | Asset (Image)                 | No       | Card image for listings.                                                                                                                          |
| `seoTitle`         | Short Text                    | Yes      | Custom `<title>` tag for the class detail page.                                                                                                   |
| `seoDescription`   | Long Text                     | Yes      | Custom meta description. Max 160 chars.                                                                                                           |
| `seoKeywords`      | Short Text                    | No       | Comma-separated keywords for meta tag.                                                                                                            |
| `relatedClasses`   | References (Class Definition) | No       | Manually curated related classes. If empty, auto-populate from same `type`.                                                                       |

**Editor Guidance:** Changing `slug` will break existing URLs. Use Contentful's "slug" validation. The `defaultDay` and `defaultTime` are editorial hints displayed on the public class detail page -- the actual session times come from the database schedule.

### 1.2 Retreat

Full editorial content for each retreat offering. Retreat _bookings_ and _availability_ are in the database; this model holds everything a prospective attendee sees on `/retreats/:slug` and `/retreats`.

| Field                        | Type                      | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`                      | Short Text                | Yes      | e.g. "Sankalpa"                                                                                                                         |
| `subtitle`                   | Short Text                | Yes      | e.g. "A Yoga Retreat for Bodies That Require Nuance"                                                                                    |
| `slug`                       | Short Text                | Yes      | URL-safe unique identifier.                                                                                                             |
| `retreatType`                | Short Text                | Yes      | Groups retreat instances by type (e.g. "Sankalpa", "Strength & Stillness"). Allows multiple dates/editions of the same retreat concept. |
| `shortDescription`           | Long Text                 | Yes      | Summary for cards on `/retreats`. Max 300 chars.                                                                                        |
| `fullDescription`            | Rich Text                 | Yes      | Full editorial copy for the retreat detail page. Supports headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, lists, embedded images.                   |
| `heroImage`                  | Asset (Image)             | Yes      | Full-width hero image on detail page. Recommended: 2100x900px landscape.                                                                |
| `cardImage`                  | Asset (Image)             | Yes      | Card image on `/retreats` listing. Recommended: 800x600px.                                                                              |
| `galleryImages`              | Assets (Image, multi)     | No       | Optional gallery for the retreat detail page.                                                                                           |
| `location`                   | Reference (Retreat Venue) | Yes      | Link to the venue content type (see 1.3).                                                                                               |
| `suitableFor`                | List (Short Text)         | Yes      | Bullet list rendered under "This Retreat Is For:".                                                                                      |
| `dailySchedule`              | JSON Object               | Yes      | Structured schedule. Schema: `[{ day: string, activities: string[] }]`. Rendered as a timeline on detail page.                          |
| `included`                   | List (Short Text)         | Yes      | "What's Included" bullet list.                                                                                                          |
| `notIncluded`                | List (Short Text)         | Yes      | "Not Included" bullet list.                                                                                                             |
| `importantInfo`              | List (Short Text)         | No       | Rendered in the sidebar info box (e.g. "Travel insurance required", "Full payment due at booking").                                     |
| `faq`                        | JSON Object               | No       | Retreat-specific FAQ. Schema: `[{ question: string, answer: string }]`. If empty, fall back to global retreat FAQ (see 1.10).           |
| `cancellationPolicyOverride` | Rich Text                 | No       | If this retreat has a different cancellation policy than the global default. If empty, display the global policy.                       |
| `earlyBirdPrice`             | Decimal                   | Yes      | Price in GBP during early bird period.                                                                                                  |
| `normalPrice`                | Decimal                   | Yes      | Price in GBP after early bird deadline.                                                                                                 |
| `earlyBirdDeadline`          | Date                      | Yes      | Date after which `normalPrice` applies.                                                                                                 |
| `currency`                   | Short Text                | Yes      | Default: "GBP".                                                                                                                         |
| `singleRoomSupplement`       | Decimal                   | No       | Additional cost for single room, if available. e.g. 200.                                                                                |
| `discountCoupon`             | Short Text                | No       | Stripe discount coupon ID for this retreat.                                                                                             |
| `promoCode`                  | Short Text                | No       | Stripe promo code ID.                                                                                                                   |
| `seoTitle`                   | Short Text                | Yes      |                                                                                                                                         |
| `seoDescription`             | Long Text                 | Yes      |                                                                                                                                         |
| `seoKeywords`                | Short Text                | No       |                                                                                                                                         |
| `status`                     | Short Text (enum)         | Yes      | One of: `draft`, `published`, `sold_out`, `archived`. Only `published` and `sold_out` appear on the site.                               |

### 1.3 Retreat Venue (Location)

Reusable content type for retreat locations. A venue can be used across multiple retreats (e.g. the same Portuguese villa for different years).

| Field                | Type                  | Required | Notes                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------- | --------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`               | Short Text            | Yes      | e.g. "Casa da Luz"                                                                                                                     |
| `displayLocation`    | Short Text            | Yes      | Human-readable location for cards/headers. e.g. "Portuguese Countryside" or "Scottish Highlands".                                      |
| `country`            | Short Text            | Yes      | e.g. "Portugal"                                                                                                                        |
| `region`             | Short Text            | No       | e.g. "Alentejo"                                                                                                                        |
| `description`        | Rich Text             | Yes      | Full venue description rendered under "Accommodation" on the retreat detail page. Include room types, facilities, accessibility notes. |
| `accommodationType`  | Short Text            | Yes      | e.g. "Traditional Portuguese villa with shared twin rooms, ensuite bathrooms, pool, and gardens."                                      |
| `facilities`         | List (Short Text)     | No       | e.g. ["Pool", "Gardens", "Gym equipment", "Communal kitchen", "WiFi"].                                                                 |
| `accessibilityNotes` | Rich Text             | No       | Details about wheelchair access, step-free areas, ground floor rooms, etc. Critical for this audience.                                 |
| `nearestAirport`     | Short Text            | No       | e.g. "Lisbon (LIS) -- 1.5 hours by car".                                                                                               |
| `transfersIncluded`  | Boolean               | Yes      | Whether airport transfers are included in the retreat price.                                                                           |
| `transferDetails`    | Short Text            | No       | e.g. "Airport pickup from Lisbon (afternoon arrivals only)".                                                                           |
| `images`             | Assets (Image, multi) | Yes      | Venue photos.                                                                                                                          |
| `mapEmbedUrl`        | Short Text            | No       | Google Maps embed URL for the location.                                                                                                |
| `timezone`           | Short Text            | Yes      | IANA timezone. e.g. "Europe/Lisbon". Needed for schedule rendering.                                                                    |

**Editor Guidance:** For online/virtual retreats, create a venue entry with `name`: "Online", `displayLocation`: "Online (Live via Video)", and `description` explaining the virtual setup (camera policy, tech requirements, etc.).

## 2. Database Schema (Prisma)

This section describes the **target** Prisma schema after migration. It is reconciled with the existing production schema -- see Appendix A for the full migration plan.

### 2.1 Architectural Decisions

| Decision          | Choice                                                                                                                    | Rationale                                                                                                     |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ORM               | Prisma                                                                                                                    | Existing production system                                                                                    |
| Auth              | NextAuth.js (Account/Session/VerificationToken models)                                                                    | Existing, proven in production. No migration to custom JWT.                                                   |
| Video platform    | Daily.co                                                                                                                  | Existing infrastructure. All references to "Zoom" in the frontend are replaced with Daily.co `roomId`.        |
| Credit system     | Individual credit records with expiry + transaction log (existing `Credit` / `CreditTransaction` models)                  | Superior to a simple counter. Supports expiry, bundle tracking, refunds.                                      |
| Access control    | Feature-based `Permission` / `UserPermission` tables + convenience `role` field on User                                   | More flexible than a simple role enum. Supports granular admin splits (teaching ops vs. business financials). |
| ID strategy       | `cuid()` (existing)                                                                                                       | All existing IDs are cuid format. No migration to UUID.                                                       |
| User name         | Split into `firstName` / `lastName`                                                                                       | Required for email personalisation, admin display. Migrated from existing `name` field.                       |
| Deprecated tables | `OnDemandClass`, `FavouritedClasses`, `OnDemandWatchLog`, `InPersonVenue`, `InPersonMember`, `InPersonClass` are archived | Data retained but no longer written to by the application. Prefixed with `_archived_` in schema comments.     |

### 2.2 User

```prisma
model User {
  id                        String              @id @default(cuid())
  firstName                 String?             // NEW - split from name
  lastName                  String?             // NEW - split from name
  name                      String?             // DEPRECATED - kept for rollback safety, do not use in new code
  email                     String              @unique
  emailVerified             DateTime?
  dob                       DateTime?           // KEEP - Required for 18+ insurance validation
  gender                    String?             // KEEP - Optional demographic, for reporting
  ethnicity                 String?             // KEEP - Optional demographic, for reporting
  image                     String?
  role                      String              @default("student") // NEW - convenience field: student | admin | instructor

  // Consent tracking
  terms                     Boolean?
  terms_signed_on           String?
  waiver                    Boolean?
  waiver_signed_on          String?
  medical_consent           Boolean?
  medical_consent_signed_on String?
  marketing                 Boolean?
  marketing_signed_on       String?

  // Stripe
  stripeCustomerId          String?             @unique

  // Internationalisation
  country                   String?             @default("gbr")
  timezone                  String?             // KEEP - IANA timezone for email/schedule formatting
  dateFormat                String?             @default("24-hour") // KEEP - 24-hour vs 12-hour for i18n

  // Auth code (email magic link / verification)
  authCode                  String?             // KEEP - OTP code sent via email
  authCodeExpiry            DateTime?           // KEEP - expiry for the above

  last_login                DateTime?
  createdAt                 DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt                 DateTime            @updatedAt

  // Relations
  accounts                  Account[]
  sessions                  Session[]
  Permissions               UserPermission[]
  subscriptions             Subscriptions[]
  credits                   Credit[]
  health                    Health[]
  goals                     Goals[]
  wallet                    UserWallet?         // NEW
  Schedule                  Schedule[]
  Invoices                  Invoices[]
  RetreatBooking            RetreatBooking[]
  ProgramEnrollment         ProgramEnrollment[] // NEW
  referralsMade             Referral[]          @relation("ReferralsMade")   // NEW
  referralsReceived         Referral[]          @relation("ReferralsReceived") // NEW
  adminNotesAbout           AdminNote[]         @relation("NotesAbout")  // NEW
  adminNotesWritten         AdminNote[]         @relation("NotesWritten") // NEW
  memberTags                MemberTag[]         // NEW
  waitlistEntries           Waitlist[]          // NEW
  newsletterSubscription    NewsletterSubscriber? // NEW

  // ARCHIVED relations (data kept, not used in new code)
  favourites                FavouritedClasses[]
  OnDemandWatchLog          OnDemandWatchLog[]
  InPersonMember            InPersonMember[]
}
```

**Validation Rules (API layer):**

- `dob`: If provided, `NOW - dob >= 18 years`. Reject registration if under 18. Error message: "You must be 18 or over to register. Shruti's insurance covers adults only."
- `email`: Standard email validation + uniqueness.
- `firstName` / `lastName`: Required at registration. Min 1 char.

### 2.5 Subscriptions & Wallet

```prisma
// EXISTING - keep as-is. Direct mirror of Stripe subscription state.
model Subscriptions {
  stripe_subscription_id    String   @id
  stripe_price_id           String
  stripe_current_period_end DateTime
  status                    String
  stripe_sub_type           String
  userId                    String
  createdAt                 DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt                 DateTime @updatedAt
  User                      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

// NEW - read-optimised cache of user's current membership + referral state.
// Credit balance is NOT here -- it's computed from the Credit table (see 2.7).
model UserWallet {
  userId            String   @id
  membershipTier    String?  // 'steady' | 'committed' | 'unlimited' | null
  membershipStatus  String   @default("none") // 'active' | 'past_due' | 'cancelled' | 'none'
  referralCode      String?  @unique
  referralBalance   Decimal  @default(0) @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
  user              User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}
```

**Wallet is a cache:** The source of truth for subscription state remains the `Subscriptions` table (synced from Stripe webhooks). `UserWallet.membershipTier` and `membershipStatus` are derived from the active subscription and should be updated whenever a Stripe webhook is processed. This avoids expensive joins on every API call.

**How to compute available credits:** `SELECT SUM("remainingAmount") FROM "Credit" WHERE "userId" = ? AND "isExpired" = false AND "expiresAt" > NOW()`. This is a read query, not stored on the wallet.

### 2.7 Credits (Existing -- Minor Enum Addition)

```prisma
model Credit {
  id              String       @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  amount          Int
  remainingAmount Int
  issuedAt        DateTime     @default(now())
  expiresAt       DateTime
  isExpired       Boolean      @default(false)
  reason          CreditReason
  bundleId        String?
  stripePaymentId String?
  user            User                @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  transactions    CreditTransaction[]
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
  @@index([bundleId])
}

model CreditTransaction {
  id          String                @id @default(cuid())
  creditId    String
  amount      Int
  type        CreditTransactionType
  createdAt   DateTime              @default(now())
  bookingId   String?
  description String
  credit      Credit @relation(fields: [creditId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@index([creditId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

enum CreditReason {
  CANCELLATION
  PURCHASE
  BUNDLE_PURCHASE
  SINGLE_CLASS_PURCHASE
  ADMIN
  PROMOTIONAL
  REFUNDED
  REFERRAL_REWARD      // NEW
}

enum CreditTransactionType {
  ISSUED
  USED
  EXPIRED
  REFUNDED
}
```

**Credit Deduction Logic (Booking Flow):**
When a user books a class with pack credits:

1. Find the user's oldest non-expired credit with `remainingAmount > 0` (FIFO -- first in, first out).
2. Decrement `remainingAmount` by 1.
3. Create a `CreditTransaction` with `type: USED`, `bookingId` pointing to the new booking.

**Credit Refund Logic (Cancellation, early cancel):**

1. Find the `CreditTransaction` for the booking being cancelled.
2. Increment the original `Credit.remainingAmount` by 1 (if not expired).
3. Create a `CreditTransaction` with `type: REFUNDED`.

**Credit Expiry (Cron):**
Daily job: `UPDATE "Credit" SET "isExpired" = true WHERE "expiresAt" < NOW() AND "isExpired" = false`. Create `CreditTransaction` with `type: EXPIRED` for any remaining amount.

### 2.8 Live Online Classes (Gradual Migration)

This is the existing `LiveOnlineClass` model with new fields added for the migration. Deprecated fields are marked -- they will be removed in a future cleanup phase once all sessions have a `classDefinitionId` and content is served from Contentful.

```prisma
model LiveOnlineClass {
  id           String              @id @default(cuid())

  // ── DEPRECATED CONTENT FIELDS (migrating to Contentful) ──
  // These fields are still populated for historical sessions.
  // New sessions should have classDefinitionId set and content fetched from Contentful.
  name         String              // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful via classDefinitionId
  length       Int                 // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful
  intent       ClassIntent         // DEPRECATED - maps to Contentful class type
  description  String              // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful
  style        String              // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful
  props        String[]            // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful
  thumbnailUrl String              // DEPRECATED - read from Contentful

  // ── CORE SESSION FIELDS ──
  roomId       String              // Daily.co room ID
  date         DateTime            @default(now()) // Session start time
  cancelledAt  DateTime?
  cancelReason String?
  createdAt    DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime            @updatedAt
  type         LiveOnlineClassType @default(FREE_FLOWING)

  // ── NEW FIELDS ──
  classDefinitionId  String?       // Contentful Entry ID. Nullable during migration.
  instructorId       String?       // FK to User (instructor). Nullable during migration.
  endTime            DateTime?     // Computed from date + length for existing rows. Set explicitly for new rows.
  capacity           Int           @default(15)
  status             String        @default("scheduled") // scheduled | cancelled | completed
  replayUrl          String?       // Daily.co recording URL or external hosting URL
  replayExpiresAt    DateTime?     // NOW + 7 days after class completes
  autoCancelExempt   Boolean       @default(false) // Admin override for 90-minute rule
  notes              String?       // Internal admin notes

  // Relations
  attendees    Schedule[]
  instructor   User?       @relation("InstructorSessions", fields: [instructorId], references: [id])

  @@index([date])
  @@index([classDefinitionId])
  @@index([status])
}

enum LiveOnlineClassType {
  FREE_FLOWING
  CHARITY
}

enum ClassIntent {
  build
  explore
  mindfulness
}
```

**API Layer Behavior During Migration:**

```
function getClassContent(session: LiveOnlineClass) {
  if (session.classDefinitionId) {
    // NEW PATH: fetch from Contentful (cached)
    return contentfulClient.getEntry(session.classDefinitionId);
  } else {
    // LEGACY PATH: use inline fields
    return {
      name: session.name,
      description: session.description,
      duration: `${session.length} min`,
      type: intentToType(session.intent), // build->Strength, explore->HIIT, mindfulness->Yoga
      // etc.
    };
  }
}
```

This means **existing sessions keep working** with their inline data, while new sessions use Contentful. Over time, you can backfill `classDefinitionId` on historical sessions if you want a consistent archive, or just leave them -- the dual-path query handles it.

### 2.12 Retreats (New Structure)

The old `Retreat` model combined content + transactional data. Content moves to Contentful (Section 1.2). The database now holds only date instances and bookings.

```prisma
// NEW - replaces the transactional parts of the old Retreat model.
// Each row is a specific date run of a retreat (one retreat in Contentful may have multiple dates).
model RetreatDate {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  retreatSlug     String           // Matches Contentful retreat slug
  retreatType     String           // e.g. "Sankalpa", "Strength & Stillness" - denormalised from Contentful for queries
  startDate       DateTime
  endDate         DateTime
  startTime       String?          // e.g. "09:30" - for single-day/workshop retreats
  endTime         String?          // e.g. "12:00"
  timezone        String           @default("Europe/London")
  totalSpaces     Int
  price           Int              // Full price in pence
  earlyBirdPrice  Int              // Early bird price in pence
  earlyBirdDeadline DateTime
  discountCoupon  String?          // Stripe discount coupon ID
  promoCode       String?          // Stripe promo code ID
  roomId          String?          // Daily.co room ID (for virtual retreats)
  status          String           @default("available") // available | sold_out | cancelled
  isActive        Boolean          @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt
  bookings        RetreatBooking[]

  @@index([retreatSlug])
  @@index([startDate])
  @@index([status])
}

// MODIFIED - enriched from original RetreatBooking
model RetreatBooking {
  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  attendeeId      String
  retreatDateId   String    // FK to RetreatDate (was retreatId -> Retreat)

  isGift          Boolean   @default(false)
```

## 3. API Endpoints

### 3.1 Authentication (NextAuth-wrapped)

Authentication is handled by NextAuth.js. The API layer wraps NextAuth's session management.

| Method  | Path                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST`  | `/api/auth/[...nextauth]` | NextAuth catch-all route. Handles login, callback, signout.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `POST`  | `/api/auth/register`      | Custom: Create user, validate 18+ from `dob`, split name into `firstName`/`lastName`, auto-create `UserWallet` row, optionally subscribe to newsletter. Triggers: Welcome Email.                                        |
| `POST`  | `/api/auth/send-code`     | Send auth code to email. Sets `authCode` and `authCodeExpiry` (e.g. NOW + 10 minutes) on User.                                                                                                                          |
| `POST`  | `/api/auth/verify-code`   | Verify email auth code. Checks `authCode` matches and `authCodeExpiry > NOW`.                                                                                                                                           |

```json
  },

    "isWithinWindow": false,
    "autoDisableAt": "2026-02-24T07:30:00Z"
  }
}
```

**`class.source`**: Either `"contentful"` (new sessions) or `"legacy"` (pre-migration sessions with inline data). Frontend renders identically; this is for debugging.

**`disabledReason` enum values:**

- `null` -- bookable
- `"full"` -- no seats remaining
- `"cancelled"` -- session cancelled
- `"ninety_minute_rule"` -- within 90 min of start and no bookings (auto-cancel pending)
- `"already_booked"` -- user already has a booking
- `"past"` -- session has already started/completed
- `"no_credits"` -- user has no credits or active membership

### 3.4 Booking Flow

**`POST /api/bookings`**

Request: `{ sessionId: string }`

Logic:

1. **Age Validation:** User must have `dob` set and be 18+. If not, 403 with `{ reason: "age_verification_required", message: "You must be 18 or over to book. Please update your date of birth in your profile." }`.
2. **Session Validation:**
   - Is session status `scheduled`? If not, 409 Conflict.
   - Is session full? (`confirmed_bookings >= capacity`) If so, 409 Conflict.
   - Has session already started? (`date < NOW`) If so, 409 Conflict.
   - **90-Minute Rule:** Is `date < NOW + 90 minutes` AND `confirmed_bookings == 0` AND `autoCancelExempt == false`? If so, 403 with `{ reason: "ninety_minute_rule", message: "Bookings are closed for this session. Classes with no sign-ups are automatically cancelled 90 minutes before start time." }`.
3. **User Validation:**
   - Already booked? (`@@unique([userId, liveOnlineClassId])` constraint) 409 Conflict.
4. **Payment Check (in priority order):**
   - Active subscription (`Subscriptions` with `status = 'active'`)? -> `creditType = 'membership'`, `bookedWithMembership = true`.
   - Available credits (`Credit` table, `SUM(remainingAmount) > 0` where not expired)? -> Deduct 1 via FIFO. `creditType = 'pack'`, `bookedWithMembership = false`.
   - Else -> 402 Payment Required with `{ reason: "no_credits", upgradeUrl: "/pricing" }`.
5. **Create Booking:** Insert `Schedule` row. Create `CreditTransaction` if pack credit used.
6. **Post-booking Triggers:**
   - Send **Booking Confirmation Email** with `.ics` attachment. Format times per user's `timezone` and `dateFormat`.
   - **Instructor Alert:** If `confirmed_bookings` went from `0 -> 1`, send **Instructor First Signup Notification**.

---

**`DELETE /api/bookings/:bookingId`**

Logic:

1. Verify booking belongs to authenticated user.
2. Verify booking `status` is `confirmed` (or `cancelledAt` is null for legacy rows).
3. **Cancellation Policy Check:**
   - If `NOW < session.date - 12 hours`: **Early cancellation**. Refund credit (reverse the `CreditTransaction`, increment `Credit.remainingAmount`). Set `refunded = true`.
   - If `NOW >= session.date - 12 hours`: **Late cancellation**. No credit refund. Set `refunded = false`.
4. Update booking: `status = 'cancelled'`, `cancelledAt = NOW`.
5. **Post-cancellation Triggers:**
   - Send **Booking Cancellation Confirmation Email** (with note about whether credit was refunded).
   - **Instructor Alert:** If `confirmed_bookings` went from `1 -> 0`, send **Instructor Last Cancel Notification**.
   - **Waitlist:** If there's a waitlist for this session and a spot just opened, notify first waitlisted user.

### 3.5 Retreat Booking Flow

**`GET /api/retreats/:slug/availability`**

Returns retreat dates with real-time availability:

```json
{
  "retreatSlug": "sankalpa",
  "dates": [
    {
      "id": "cuid",
      "startDate": "2026-09-15",
      "endDate": "2026-09-20",
      "totalSpaces": 12,
      "confirmedBookings": 4,
      "availableSpaces": 8,
      "status": "available",
      "price": 165000,
      "earlyBirdPrice": 145000,
      "isEarlyBird": true,
      "earlyBirdDeadline": "2026-07-01"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Note:** Prices are in pence (matching existing Retreat model convention). Frontend converts to pounds for display.

**`POST /api/retreats/book`**

Request:

```json
{
  "retreatDateId": "cuid",
  "singleRoom": false,
  "phone": "+44...",
  "emergencyName": "...",
  "emergencyPhone": "...",
  "dietaryReqs": "Vegan, nut allergy",
  "medicalConditions": "Psoriatic arthritis, managed with ...",
  "mobilityNeeds": "Ground floor room preferred",
  "agreedTerms": true,
  "agreedHealthDec": true,
  "isGift": false,
  "giftMessage": null
}
```

Logic:

1. **Age Validation:** Must be 18+.
2. Validate retreat date exists, `status = 'available'`, has spaces.
3. Validate all required fields (emergencyName, emergencyPhone, agreedTerms, agreedHealthDec).
4. Create `RetreatBooking` row with `status = 'pending_payment'`.
5. Create Stripe Checkout session with correct price (early bird vs. normal + single room supplement). Apply `discountCoupon`/`promoCode` if set on the `RetreatDate`.
6. Return Stripe Checkout URL.
7. On Stripe webhook `checkout.session.completed`:
   - Update booking `status = 'confirmed'`, `paid = true`.
   - Create `Payments` row.
   - Send **Retreat Booking Confirmation Email** (different template from class -- includes venue details, transfer info, packing suggestions, health declaration confirmation). Format dates per user's timezone.
   - If retreat date is now full, update `RetreatDate.status = 'sold_out'`.

**`DELETE /api/retreat-bookings/:bookingId`**

Logic:

1. Calculate refund tier:
   - `> 60 days before start`: Full refund.
   - `30-60 days before start`: 50% refund.
   - `< 30 days before start`: No refund (unless spot can be filled -- manual admin decision).
2. Process Stripe refund (full or partial).
3. Update booking status to `'cancelled'` or `'refunded'`.
4. Send cancellation confirmation email with refund details.
5. If retreat date was `sold_out` and now has space, update status to `available`.

### 3.6 Small Group Program Enrollment

**`POST /api/programs/enroll`**

Request: `{ programInstanceId: string }`

Logic:

1. Validate program instance exists, status is `enrolling`, has available spots.
2. Age validation (18+).
3. Create Stripe Checkout session.
4. On webhook: Create `ProgramEnrollment`, send confirmation email with program schedule and Daily.co room link.

### 3.7 Purchasing (Stripe Webhooks)

**`POST /api/webhooks/stripe`**

Handles multiple event types:

| Event                           | Action                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkout.session.completed`    | Identify user by `metadata.userId` or `stripeCustomerId`. Route by `metadata.itemType`: credit bundle -> issue credits (with expiry from `MembershipPrices.creditExpireDays`); membership -> activate subscription; retreat -> confirm booking; program -> confirm enrollment. Send appropriate confirmation email. |
| `invoice.payment_succeeded`     | Membership renewal. Update `Subscriptions.stripe_current_period_end`. Sync `UserWallet.membershipStatus = 'active'`.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `invoice.payment_failed`        | Set `UserWallet.membershipStatus = 'past_due'`. Send payment failed email. Retry logic handled by Stripe.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `customer.subscription.deleted` | Set `UserWallet.membershipStatus = 'cancelled'`, `membershipTier = null`. Update `Subscriptions.status`. Send membership ended email.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `customer.subscription.updated` | Sync `Subscriptions` table. Update `UserWallet` if tier changed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

**Credit Issuance from Bundle Purchase:**

```
1. Look up MembershipPrices by stripe_price_id from the checkout session.
2. credits = MembershipPrices.credits
3. expiresAt = NOW + MembershipPrices.creditExpireDays days
4. bundleId = generate a cuid (groups credits from this purchase)
5. Create `credits` number of Credit rows, each with amount=1, remainingAmount=1, reason=BUNDLE_PURCHASE.
6. Create CreditTransaction for each with type=ISSUED.
```

## 5. Calendar (.ics) Generation

### 5.1 Booking Confirmation (METHOD:REQUEST)

```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Shruti Turner Coaching//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{bookingId}@shrutiturner.com
DTSTAMP:{now}
DTSTART:{session.date}
DTEND:{session.endTime}
SUMMARY:{className} with Shruti Turner
DESCRIPTION:Join link: https://shrutiturner.daily.co/{roomId}\n\nClass: {className}\nLevel: {level}\n\nManage your booking: https://shrutiturner.com/dashboard
LOCATION:Online (Daily.co)
ORGANIZER;CN=Shruti Turner:mailto:shruti@shrutiturner.com
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```

**Important:** The `UID` MUST be deterministic (based on `bookingId`), not timestamp-based. Calendar clients use UID to update/cancel existing events.

### 5.2 Cancellation (METHOD:CANCEL)

Same structure but:

- `METHOD:CANCEL`
- `STATUS:CANCELLED`
- Same `UID` as the original booking (this is how calendar clients know which event to remove)

### 5.3 Retreat (Multi-day)

```
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:{startDate}
DTEND;VALUE=DATE:{endDate + 1 day}
```

Use `VALUE=DATE` (not datetime) for all-day multi-day events. End date is exclusive in iCal spec, so add 1 day.

## 6. The 90-Minute Rule

### 6.1 Overview

If no one has signed up for a class within 90 minutes of its start time, the session is automatically cancelled. This prevents Shruti from committing to teach a class nobody attends.

### 6.2 Cron Job Specification

**Name:** `auto-cancel-empty-sessions`
**Frequency:** Every 5 minutes.
**Environment:** Server-side cron (Vercel Cron, Railway cron, or similar).

**Logic:**

```sql
-- Find sessions to auto-cancel
SELECT loc.id, loc.name, loc.date
FROM "LiveOnlineClass" loc
WHERE loc.status = 'scheduled'
  AND loc."autoCancelExempt" = FALSE
  AND loc.date BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '90 minutes'
  AND loc.id NOT IN (
    SELECT s."liveOnlineClassId"
    FROM "Schedule" s
    WHERE s.status = 'confirmed'
      AND s."liveOnlineClassId" IS NOT NULL
  );

-- For each matching session:
-- 1. UPDATE "LiveOnlineClass" SET status = 'cancelled', "cancelledAt" = NOW() WHERE id = ?
-- 2. Log the cancellation
-- 3. After loop: if any cancelled, send single digest email to admin
```

### 6.3 Frontend Behavior

When displaying a session that falls within the 90-minute window with zero bookings:

1. **Book button is disabled.** Not hidden -- disabled with a tooltip.
2. **Tooltip text:** "This class hasn't reached minimum sign-ups and may be cancelled. Bookings close 90 minutes before start time."
3. **No urgency language.** Do NOT say "Book now before it's too late!" or "Only X minutes left!". The design system explicitly forbids urgency tactics.
4. **If session has >= 1 booking:** The 90-minute rule does NOT apply. Bookings remain open until the session starts. The button stays enabled.
5. **Admin override:** Sessions with `autoCancelExempt = true` are never auto-cancelled and the booking button remains enabled regardless of booking count. This is set per-session by the admin (e.g. for special events).

### 6.4 Edge Cases

- **Timezone handling:** `LiveOnlineClass.date` is stored as `DateTime` (UTC via Prisma). The 90-minute comparison uses server-side UTC time. The frontend converts to the user's local timezone (from `User.timezone`) for display only.
- **Race condition:** If a user starts a booking flow at 91 minutes before start (allowed) but completes it at 89 minutes (blocked), the booking should still succeed because it was initiated in time. Implementation: check the rule at API level only, not at Stripe webhook level.
- **Last-second cancellation:** If the sole attendee cancels at 89 minutes before start (putting it back to 0 bookings within the window), the next cron run will auto-cancel the session. This is correct behavior.

## 7. Contentful Webhook Integration

### 7.1 Webhook Endpoint

**`POST /api/webhooks/contentful`**

Contentful sends webhooks on entry publish, unpublish, and delete.

**Headers to verify:** `X-Contentful-Topic`, `X-Contentful-Webhook-Name`, plus webhook signing secret for authentication.

### 7.2 Event Handling

| Contentful Event                           | Action                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Class Definition published                 | Invalidate cache for `/api/content/classes` and `/api/content/classes/:slug`.                                          |
| Retreat published                          | Invalidate cache for `/api/content/retreats` and `/api/content/retreats/:slug`.                                        |
| Blog Post published (isNewsletter = false) | Invalidate blog cache.                                                                                                 |
| Blog Post published (isNewsletter = true)  | Invalidate blog cache + **trigger newsletter send pipeline** (queue job, don't send synchronously in webhook handler). |
| Testimonial published                      | Invalidate testimonial cache.                                                                                          |
| Page Content updated                       | Invalidate page cache for the specific slug.                                                                           |
| Legal page updated                         | Invalidate legal cache.                                                                                                |
| Global Content updated                     | Invalidate global cache (nav, footer, etc.).                                                                           |
| Any entry unpublished/deleted              | Invalidate relevant caches.                                                                                            |

### 7.3 Newsletter Send Pipeline

Triggered when a Blog Post with `isNewsletter = true` is published:

1. Webhook receives event -> enqueue `send-newsletter` job (not inline, to avoid webhook timeout).
2. Job fetches the full blog post content from Contentful.
3. Renders content through `NewsletterEmail.tsx` React Email template.
4. Fetches all active subscribers from `NewsletterSubscriber` table.
5. Sends via Postmark batch API (max 500 per batch, with rate limiting).
6. Creates `Newsletter` row with subject, content, sentAt for campaign tracking.

---

## 8. Replay Access

Class replays are available for 7 days after the class is completed.

| Rule               | Detail                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Who can access** | Only users who had a confirmed booking for that session (including late cancellations). Check `Schedule` table.                                               |
| **How long**       | 7 days from class completion (`replayExpiresAt` on `LiveOnlineClass`).                                                                                        |
| **Where**          | Authenticated page at `/dashboard/classes/:id/join` shows the replay embed if available.                                                                      |
| **Storage**        | Replay videos hosted via Daily.co recordings or external hosting. `replayUrl` stores the URL.                                                                 |
| **Expiry**         | A daily cron job sets `replayUrl = NULL, replayExpiresAt = NULL` for expired replays. Or, the frontend checks `replayExpiresAt` and hides the player if past. |

---

## 9. Infrastructure Requirements

1. **Database:** PostgreSQL (managed via Prisma, existing production setup).
2. **Email Service:** Postmark (via API).
   - Must support `.ics` calendar attachments (base64 encoded, `Content-Type: text/calendar`).
   - Batch sending for newsletters (Postmark batch API, 500/batch).
   - Separate "message streams" for transactional vs. newsletter emails (Postmark requirement for deliverability).
3. **Payments:** Stripe.
   - Checkout Sessions for one-off purchases (credit packs, retreats, programs).
   - Subscriptions for memberships.
   - Existing `stripeCustomerId` on User, `MembershipPrices` product catalog, `Payments` table.
   - Webhook endpoint with signature verification.
4. **Video:** Daily.co.
   - Room creation via Daily.co API for new sessions.
   - Recordings API for replay URLs.
   - `roomId` stored on `LiveOnlineClass` and `RetreatDate` (for virtual retreats) and `ProgramInstance`.
5. **Task Scheduler / Cron:**
   - `auto-cancel-empty-sessions`: Every 5 minutes.
   - `send-class-reminders`: Every 15 minutes (checks for sessions starting in ~2 hours).
   - `expire-replays`: Daily at midnight.
   - `expire-credits`: Daily (checks `Credit.expiresAt`).
   - `membership-renewal-reminders`: Daily (check for renewals in next 3 days).
6. **Content Cache:** Redis (or in-memory with TTL) for Contentful responses.
   - Class Definitions: 5-minute TTL.
   - Page Content: 5-minute TTL.
   - Blog posts: 5-minute TTL.
   - Global content: 5-minute TTL.
   - Invalidation via Contentful webhooks (see Section 7).
7. **Monitoring:** Error alerting on failed email sends, failed webhook processing, and cron job failures.

---

### Phase 2: Data Backfill Scripts

Run after Phase 1 deployment. These are one-time scripts, NOT in migration files.

```sql
-- 2a. Split User.name into firstName/lastName
UPDATE "User" SET
  "firstName" = TRIM(SPLIT_PART("name", ' ', 1)),
  "lastName" = CASE
    WHEN POSITION(' ' IN TRIM("name")) > 0
    THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING("name" FROM POSITION(' ' IN TRIM("name")) + 1))
    ELSE ''
  END
WHERE "name" IS NOT NULL AND "firstName" IS NULL;

-- 2b. Set User.role from existing permissions
-- (Adjust permission feature names to match your actual data)
UPDATE "User" SET "role" = 'admin'
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT up."userId"
  FROM "UserPermission" up
  JOIN "Permission" p ON up."permissionId" = p.id
  WHERE p."feature" ILIKE '%admin%'
);

-- 2c. Populate Schedule.status from cancelledAt
UPDATE "Schedule" SET "status" = 'cancelled' WHERE "cancelledAt" IS NOT NULL AND "status" = 'confirmed';

-- 2d. Populate Schedule.creditType from existing fields
UPDATE "Schedule" SET "creditType" = CASE
  WHEN "bookedWithMembership" = TRUE THEN 'membership'
  WHEN "creditUsed" IS NOT NULL AND "creditUsed" > 0 THEN 'pack'
  ELSE 'pack'
END
WHERE "creditType" IS NULL;

-- 2e. Populate LiveOnlineClass.endTime from date + length
UPDATE "LiveOnlineClass" SET
  "endTime" = "date" + ("length" || ' minutes')::INTERVAL
WHERE "endTime" IS NULL;

-- 2f. Populate LiveOnlineClass.status from state
UPDATE "LiveOnlineClass" SET "status" = CASE
  WHEN "cancelledAt" IS NOT NULL THEN 'cancelled'
  WHEN "date" < NOW() THEN 'completed'
  ELSE 'scheduled'
END
WHERE "status" = 'scheduled' AND ("cancelledAt" IS NOT NULL OR "date" < NOW());

-- 2g. Create UserWallet for all existing users
INSERT INTO "UserWallet" ("userId", "membershipTier", "membershipStatus", "referralCode", "referralBalance", "updatedAt")
SELECT
  u.id,
  -- Map stripe_sub_type to tier (adjust these values to match your actual data)
  CASE
    WHEN s."stripe_sub_type" ILIKE '%steady%' THEN 'steady'
    WHEN s."stripe_sub_type" ILIKE '%committed%' THEN 'committed'
    WHEN s."stripe_sub_type" ILIKE '%unlimited%' THEN 'unlimited'
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN s."status" = 'active' THEN 'active'
    WHEN s."status" = 'past_due' THEN 'past_due'
    WHEN s."status" IS NOT NULL THEN 'cancelled'
    ELSE 'none'
  END,
  -- Generate unique referral code: first 4 chars of name + random 4 digits
  UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(u."name", u.email), '[^a-zA-Z]', '', 'g'), 4))
    || LPAD(FLOOR(RANDOM() * 10000)::TEXT, 4, '0'),
  0,
  NOW()
FROM "User" u
LEFT JOIN "Subscriptions" s ON s."userId" = u.id
  AND s."status" IN ('active', 'past_due')
ON CONFLICT ("userId") DO NOTHING;

-- 2h. Populate NewsletterSubscriber from existing marketing consent
INSERT INTO "NewsletterSubscriber" ("id", "email", "userId", "firstName", "source", "subscribedAt", "status")
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid()::TEXT,
  u.email,
  u.id,
  u."firstName",
  'import',
  COALESCE(u."marketing_signed_on"::TIMESTAMPTZ, u."createdAt"),
  CASE WHEN u.marketing = TRUE THEN 'active' ELSE 'unsubscribed' END
FROM "User" u
WHERE u.marketing IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT ("email") DO NOTHING;
```

### Phase 3: Retreat Data Migration

This is the bold restructure. The old `Retreat` table data is mapped into the new `RetreatDate` table and existing `RetreatBooking` FK is re-pointed.

```sql
-- 3a. Create RetreatDate rows from existing Retreat rows
-- Note: using the SAME id as the old Retreat so that RetreatBooking FKs stay valid
INSERT INTO "RetreatDate" (
  "id", "retreatSlug", "retreatType", "startDate", "endDate",
  "startTime", "endTime", "timezone", "totalSpaces",
  "price", "earlyBirdPrice", "earlyBirdDeadline",
  "discountCoupon", "promoCode", "roomId",
  "status", "isActive", "createdAt", "updatedAt"
)
SELECT
  r.id,                          -- SAME ID as old Retreat
  r.slug,
  r."retreatType",
  r.date,                        -- startDate = date
  r.date,                        -- endDate = date (adjust manually for multi-day retreats after migration)
  r."startTime",
  r."endTime",
  r.timezone,
  r."maxAttendees",
  r.price,
  r."earlyBirdPrice",
  r."earlyBirdDeadline",
  r."discountCoupon",
  r."promoCode",
  r."roomId",
  CASE WHEN r."isActive" THEN 'available' ELSE 'cancelled' END,
  r."isActive",
  r."createdAt",
  r."updatedAt"
FROM "Retreat" r;

-- 3b. Rename FK column on RetreatBooking
ALTER TABLE "RetreatBooking" RENAME COLUMN "retreatId" TO "retreatDateId";

-- 3c. Update FK constraint

ALTER TABLE "RetreatBooking" ADD CONSTRAINT "RetreatBooking_retreatDateId_fkey"
  FOREIGN KEY ("retreatDateId") REFERENCES "RetreatDate"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE;
```

### Phase 4: Contentful Content Population

1. Create all Contentful content models from Section 1.
2. For each distinct class (from `LiveOnlineClass` unique `name` values):
   - Create a Contentful Class Definition entry.
   - Note the Contentful Entry ID.
   - Update matching `LiveOnlineClass` rows: `UPDATE "LiveOnlineClass" SET "classDefinitionId" = '{entry_id}' WHERE name = '{class_name}'`.
3. For each retreat (from `_archived_Retreat` rows):
   - Create Contentful Retreat entry with content fields (name, description, etc.).
   - Create Contentful Retreat Venue entry for each unique location.
4. Migrate blog content, testimonials, page content into Contentful.

### Phase 5: Code Cutover

1. Deploy new API layer with dual-path content resolution (Contentful or legacy inline).
2. Deploy new frontend.
3. New sessions created via admin always set `classDefinitionId`.

### Rollback Strategy

- Phase 1 additions are all nullable/defaulted -- old code continues working.
- Phase 3 (retreat restructure) is the riskiest. The `_archived_Retreat` table serves as the rollback target. If something goes wrong:
  1. `ALTER TABLE "_archived_Retreat" RENAME TO "Retreat";`
  2. Revert the `RetreatBooking` FK changes.
  3. Deploy old code.
- Phase 2 backfills are idempotent (use `WHERE ... IS NULL` guards). Safe to re-run.
